note: An airline answer that also names another lane's rate and transit time: two labelled transit times disagree, `bids._days` refuses and the model reads the bid. Owner: Accuracy.

Several shipments: the same lane twice with different cargo. `extract.shipments` splits only lines with different airports (a lot list must stay one shipment), so the second is not quoted. Owner: Cost (`extract.py`).

Several shipments, each collected at its own postcode: `extract.shipments` reads each line's postcode, but a further shipment keeps the first one's airport; its own zone airport needs `store.airport_of` (`agent.handle`). Owner: Cost (`extract.py`).

Several shipments not written one numbered or bulleted line each: a paragraph per shipment, a table in the body, 'we also have' in running text. `extract.shipments` splits `SHIPMENT_LINE`s only, so one shipment is quoted. Owner: Cost (`extract.py`).
Several shipments: a further shipment only in the subject. `extract.shipments` reads the body's lines, so it is not quoted. Owner: Cost (`extract.py`).

Several shipments only in attachments: one packing list per shipment or one list with a section each. `extract.shipments` reads the mail's lines, the documents give one shipment's cargo. Owner: Cost (`extract.py`).

Several shipments with a wish for one of them (cheapest for one and fastest for the other, an airline ruled out or a latest arrival for shipment 2 only): `extract.shipments` copies the mail's wishes to every shipment. Owner: Cost (`extract.py`).
